worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.summary: Pours a flame that grows longer each tick, sweeping a lane (or a fan) out in front; everyone caught takes a hit and may be set alight, and the jet only stops once it is spent.
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.use.0: Pour a flame that grows longer
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.use.1: Sweep everyone stacked in one lane
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.use.2: Sweep a whole fan of foes in front at once
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.descripti: The flame advances %3$s blocks/tick out to %2$s blocks, dealing about %1$s special damage to each enemy it reaches; each target is hit once.
A scorched target has a %1$s chance to burn for about 40 s: it loses about 1/16 of its maximum health every 5 s and its physical attacks deal half damage. Fire-type targets cannot be ignited.
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.wide.on: Fan: opens about %1$s degrees, ignition +5%%, catching more targets, but power ×0.82, length ×0.78, +2 wind-up and +6 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.wide.off: Focused: a narrow lance with a lateral radius of about %1$s blocks, heavier on one target, farther and faster, at the cost of coverage.
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.growth.0: From level %1$s the flame rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks long.
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.growth.1: From level %1$s the flame rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks long.
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.preferenc: On: opens about 30 degrees, ignition +5%%, catching more targets, but power x0.82, length x0.78, +2 wind-up and +6 cooldown. Off (focused): a narrow lance, heavier on one target, farther and faster, at the cost of coverage.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: prefers the jet when another enemy is within 3 blocks of the target, burning a line at once; off: order by ordinary attack only.
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.descripti: The whole jet can scorch at most %1$s different targets.
The user stands still while pouring the flame.
